text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O is training to do multiple 1,200-meter races in quick succession. Day after day, she does her best in her training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she doesn't want to make sprinting all she's known for. I might not be able to convince her to do more sprints after this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I walk the academy grounds, mulling this over when…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Good for you, Flower! The teacher said you were quick to take action!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's only because you helped me, Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I think it would have taken me a while to carry five books by myself.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your help.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: There's no need to thank me! It's only natural things should speed up with me around!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bakushin O! Do you remember what we have planned for tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Of course I do! You wanted to learn how best to do a starting dash, right?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: I'm glad you do. Thanks in advance.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Wait, isn't it about time for the celebrations? Everyone's been looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's already this late?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll be there at once! Flower, you're coming with me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: P-please… wait just one moment!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For there to be a celebration, something good must've happened to Sakura Bakushin O. I decide to see what the fuss is about.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm pleased to announce…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I, Sakura Bakushin O, have shortened my record time for speed-changing out of my uniform and into my tracksuit by five seconds!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Speed-changing…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for gathering here today to celebrate this momentous occasion!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Congratulations! Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thank you, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Flower? I'm fast with my legs and my clothes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I also hold the record for taking the quickest early lunch! Although it's about time I revisit that one!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um… That's quite the achievement!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Lately you've been way more in the zone. Like your speed is really getting up there.

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text: Yeah! The homeroom teacher said something about that too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh! What did they say?

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text: They said they were thankful you brought the documents to them so quickly. Also that it'd be even better if they came in a bit neater too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haha, oh Teacher, you! You don't have to compliment me that much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I feel so honored as class representative!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Your speed is the only thing about you we know we can rely on. We're counting on you, Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: They're counting on me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The reasons for the celebrations give me a chuckle, but I do get to see Sakura Bakushin O be doted on by her classmates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later on while walking the grounds, I find Sakura Bakushin O and Nishino Flower together, seemingly done with the celebrations.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Phew, I sure was praised a lot! As is par for the course for the ideal class representative!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah ha ha…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I noticed that everyone really admires you, Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's right! Being admired is basically my job as class representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm new and improved! Here stands the class representative to rule all class representatives!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Thanks to my trainer's spot-on training methods, I've been on a roll!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you sure have.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Right! I want to run long distance, so I'm working on acing three sprints!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …What?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, isn't that… just doing sprints over and over?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm? Was that the sound of someone's heart leaping out their chest right now?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Anyway, running three sprints also makes for a wonderful long-distance run. Perhaps it's still too early for you to comprehend, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: R-right…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I can't go wrong if I'm following my trainer's advice!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You know, since training with them, I've only been asked for more and more favors.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My trainer will definitely make my dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I guess you really trust your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Of course I do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I didn't expect to hear Sakura Bakushin O's heartfelt feelings like this. Her words light a fire in me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's only right to guide her properly now I know she trusts me. I'll lead her down a Bakushin Road where she can truly shine!
